# EquipmentTree

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Hierarchy of equipment (site, area, unit, module) with a status per node, that the operator expands, collapses and selects (IND-119).

![EquipmentTree, light theme](../img/widgets/equipment-tree-light.png#only-light){ width="328" }
![EquipmentTree, dark theme](../img/widgets/equipment-tree-dark.png#only-dark){ width="328" }

**Recipes and plant structure** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.EquipmentTree) ·
schema [`equipmenttree.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.EquipmentTree(
    value="P-102",
    label="EquipmentTree",
    expanded=["Plant", "Plant/Mixing"],
    nodes=[
        {
            "label": "Plant",
            "level": "site",
            "children": [
                {
                    "label": "Mixing",
                    "level": "area",
                    "status": "normal",
                    "children": [
                        {"label": "Mixer M-101", "level": "unit", "status": "running"},
                        {
                            "id": "P-102",
                            "label": "Pump P-102",
                            "level": "equipment",
                            "status": "alarm",
                        },
                        {
                            "label": "Valve XV-103",
                            "level": "equipment",
                            "status": "maintenance",
                        },
                    ],
                },
                {
                    "label": "Packing",
                    "level": "area",
                    "children": [
                        {"label": "Filler", "level": "unit", "status": "stopped"},
                        {"label": "Capper", "level": "unit", "status": "fault"},
                    ],
                },
            ],
        },
        {
            "label": "Utilities",
            "level": "area",
            "status": "warning",
            "children": [{"label": "Boiler", "level": "unit", "status": "offline"}],
        },
    ],
    size=(320, 240),
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"control"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `size` | array | `[320,280]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | string | `""` | host, widget | Id of the selected node, empty for none. Set by the host, or by the operator selecting a node in control mode. |
| `nodes` | array of object | `[]` | host | Root nodes, each {label, id, level, status, children}. Python rejects a node without a label, an unknown status or a repeated id; without a kernel such a node (and its children) is skipped. |
| `expanded` | array of string | `[]` | host, widget | Ids of the expanded nodes. Set by the host, or by the operator expanding and collapsing nodes. |
| `show_level` | boolean | `true` | host | Show the level of each node next to its label. |
